detail.longDescription: I can't think of many apps that inspire the kind of devotion that Notion does. Its fans organize meetups all around the world to chat about productivity systems, from Aruba to Poland to Pakistan. Heck, you can buy Notion onesies for your baby. My theory on Notion's popularity is this: because you can use it to organize pretty much anything, it's become the software equivalent of a self-help book. Whether you're struggling with school, work, or your personal life, there's a Notion template design
